The plate is a square dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across, spanning about 460 px, so about 0.056 cm per px... more precisely about 17.7 px per cm.

The rice pile is about 210 px by 280 px, which is roughly 12 cm by 16 cm. Its irregular shape covers perhaps 100 cm². At a depth of about 1.5 cm, that gives roughly 150 cm³. Cooked brown rice packs at around 0.65 g/cm³, so the pile weighs about 100-150 g. I'll use 140 g.

Cooked brown rice has about 1.1-1.2 kcal/g, so 140 g is about 160 kcal. The rice appears to have a few bits of carrot and possibly a little oil, so I'll round up to 170 kcal.
